title: Verify open-tab update recovery across a deployment
acceptance: At an owner-authorized future deployment, an already-open tab receives the update prompt, can reload after a page crash, and loads the new asset.
Record old/new asset identifiers and observed recovery; preserve Live safety behavior.
nextAction: Arrange an attended check during a separately authorized deployment; do not deploy just to close this task.

evidence.summary: RF-11 explicitly carried a deferred open-tab proof.
